items.title: Joe Lyde Interview, 1959-05-18
items.q: I went to London, I heard Ken Collier's band in 1949, the Crane River Jazz Band.

ctx.x: Uh, every Saturday, but they play anywhere. They've, they've been playing at the boat club. Uh, it's very different to some of the boat clubs I've played in over here. It's, it's not a big bar, you know, more like across, you know, kind of thing. Yeah. All the mill girls go over there. Belfast is an industrial town. Uh-huh. Oh, it's very different in Belfast, if you're interested. I mean, Belfast is kind of a backwater, but it's very different. The approach to jazz over there always seemed to me, this is before I…
